definitions.explanation: A traditional style of garden unique to Japan, featuring elements such as rocks, water, sand, moss, trees, and bridges arranged to create miniature natural landscapes. Distinct from Western gardens in philosophy and design.

examples.japanese: {日本庭園|にほんていえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散策|さんさく}→散策：07618_sansaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To stroll through a Japanese garden.

examples.english: In Japanese gardens, natural landscapes are condensed and expressed in miniature.

notes: Composed of ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ (Japan) + ⟦{庭園|ていえん}→庭園：12452_teien⟧ (garden). Major types include: {枯山水|かれさんすい} (dry landscape garden, using rocks and raked sand to represent water), {池泉回遊式|ちせんかいゆうしき} (pond strolling garden), and {茶庭|ちゃにわ}/{露地|ろじ} (tea garden). Famous examples include {龍安寺|りょうあんじ} in Kyoto (renowned for its {枯山水|かれさんすい}), {兼六園|けんろくえん} in Kanazawa, and {後楽園|こうらくえん} in Okayama. Common collocations: {日本庭園|にほんていえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{造|つく}る→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧ (to create a Japanese garden), {日本庭園|にほんていえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧ (maintenance of a Japanese garden).
